detailed_descriptions.en: Get the mining upgrade for your drone! Program it to dig, explore, and mine underground resources. Using a simple Python-like language, automate excavation, optimize mining routes, and uncover valuable minerals hidden deep beneath the surface. Unlock 8 new underground resources, including coal, quartz, mushrooms and dynamite! Solve various new problems via code, such as digging up ancient ruins without damaging them, sorting colorful mushrooms, and finally learning how to play Minesweeper without blowing up your mining drone. Whether you're a programming novice or a seasoned professional, The Miner Was Replaced has new challenges for every skill level.
